description: Get one of Quantamentry's ranked inflation lists by country, computed daily from each country's official consumer price index (ILOSTAT, CC BY 4.0). Screens: 'highest-inflation' (Year-over-year inflation for every country with a print in the last six months, highest first.); 'lowest-inflation' (Where consumer prices are rising slowest.); 'deflation' (Countries where prices are lower than a year ago.); 'hyperinflation' (Three-year cumulative inflation against the 100% line.); 'double-digit-inflation' (Countries with inflation of 10% or more, grouped into four bands.); 'inflation-rising' (Where the rate rose by half a point or more between the last two prints.); 'inflation-falling' (Where the rate fell by half a point or more between the last two prints.); 'inflation-since-2020' (How much prices have risen since January 2020, country by country.); 'hyperinflation-watchlist' (Economies between 70% and 100% on the three-year test, with their last twelve months.) Returns a one-sentence answer, the full table, and each figure's print month (countries publish on different schedules, so months differ by row). Free, no key needed.

screen.description: Which list to return, e.g. 'deflation' or 'highest-inflation'.

name: get_inflation_screen
